verdict.rationale: SvelteKit is Svelte's first-party app framework, documented at svelte.dev/docs/kit and set up by the official sv CLI. It is positioned as Svelte's equivalent of Next/Nuxt, supporting SPA and SSG modes. Community users describe its folder-based route hierarchy and clear load structure, which confirms integrated routing. missing for 10: first-party docs describing the routing API itself (routes, params, navigation), evidence of a standalone router library rather than a full meta-framework, and independent corroboration of seamless integration beyond brief community comments.
